Begin your child's journey with SEVAI Shanthi.

Admissions are open every year from April for classes Pre-KG through Class 12. Here is everything you need to know to get started.

Admissions Open
Every April
Classes Available
Pre-KG to Class 12
Medium
English Medium
Who Can Apply

Open to all students, Pre-KG through Class 12

We welcome students at every stage of their schooling journey — from early childhood through higher secondary.

Early Years

Pre-KG, LKG & UKG

Our early childhood programme follows Montessori methodology, building curiosity, motor skills, and social confidence from the very beginning. Free transport available for LKG & UKG from all areas.

Primary & Middle

Class 1 – Class 10

An English-medium, State Board curriculum delivered through enquiry-based learning, smart classrooms, field visits, and strong teacher mentorship — building a solid academic foundation.

Higher Secondary

Class 11 & Class 12

Three focused streams — Bio-Maths, Computer Science, and Commerce — to help students specialise based on their strengths and career goals, supported by fully equipped labs and experienced faculty.

How to Apply

Simple 4-step admission process

We have kept the process straightforward so that every family can apply without any hassle.

1

Contact the School

Call us or visit the school office during working hours — Mon to Sat, 9 AM to 5 PM — to express your interest and get initial guidance.

2

Collect the Form

Pick up the admission application form from the school office. Our staff will help you fill it in correctly and answer any questions.

3

Submit Documents

Submit the completed form along with the required documents listed below. On-spot admission is available, especially for Kindergarten.

4

Confirmation

Once your documents are verified, admission is confirmed and your child is all set to join the SEVAI Shanthi family.

What to Bring

Required Documents

Please carry the following documents when you visit us for admission.

Birth Certificate

Official birth certificate of the student

Aadhar Card

Student's Aadhar card (or parent's Aadhar if student's is unavailable)

Community Certificate

Caste/community certificate issued by the appropriate authority

Passport Size Photo

Recent passport size photograph of the student

Higher Secondary Streams

Choosing the right group

For students joining Class 11, we offer three groups. Our teachers are happy to guide you in selecting the right one based on your child's interests and goals.

Group 1 — Bio-Maths Science

Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology — ideal for students aiming for Medicine, Engineering, or Life Sciences.

Group 2 — Computer Science

Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Computer Science — ideal for students aiming for IT, Software, or Technology fields.

Group 3 — Commerce

Commerce, Accountancy, Economics, Computer Applications — ideal for students aiming for Business, Finance, or Management.

Ready to enrol your child?

Call us or visit the school office. We are happy to meet you and guide you through the process in person.
